name: cdn-bench_49ae25ff-dba4-4669-a9dd-a5e90d083040_1748623540
description: A benchmark dataset for measuring CDN performance across providers, regions and configurations. It collects numeric metrics such as latency, throughput and availability under different workloads and network conditions to enable evaluation and comparison of CDN setups and caching strategies. Typical uses include regression and time-series analysis to predict or compare performance and SLA compliance.
evaluation_method: throughput/latency metrics (percentiles such as P50/P95), average throughput and availability
reputation: A niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited community adoption outside practitioners interested in CDN performance testing.
